title: Add Skip Button and Countdown Timer to Quiz Screen

requirements.text: In QuizScreen.tsx, add a 'Skip' button alongside the existing 'Next' button. When the user clicks 'Skip', the current question is recorded as skipped (no answer selected) and the quiz advances to the next question. Skipped questions must be tracked in the answers array passed to onComplete so the ResultsScreen can display a skipped count. The Skip button must be disabled or hidden on the last question (where the user must submit or skip to end the quiz). Apply the existing parchment/teal/gold theme styling to the Skip button.

quotes: Add a skip button and clock durin quiz

acceptanceCriteria: A 'Skip' button is visible on every question card during the quiz except it either submits/ends the quiz on the last question or is replaced by a 'Finish' action.
Clicking Skip advances to the next question without requiring an answer selection.
Skipped questions are recorded distinctly (e.g., selectedAnswer = null or a sentinel value) in the answers array passed to onComplete.
The ResultsScreen correctly counts and displays the number of skipped questions.
The Skip button is styled consistently with the existing parchment/teal/gold theme.

requirements.text: In QuizScreen.tsx, add a visible countdown timer displayed prominently at the top of the quiz card (e.g., near the question counter). The timer should count down from a fixed duration of 60 seconds per question. When the timer reaches zero, the current question is automatically skipped and the quiz advances to the next question. The timer must reset to 60 seconds each time a new question is shown. Display the remaining time in MM:SS format (e.g., '01:00'). Style the timer with the existing teal/gold theme; turn the timer text red when 10 or fewer seconds remain to warn the user.

quotes: Add a skip button and clock durin quiz

acceptanceCriteria: A countdown timer is visible on the quiz card during the quiz, showing remaining time in MM:SS format.
The timer starts at 60 seconds when each new question is displayed and counts down in real time.
When the timer reaches 0, the question is automatically skipped and the quiz advances to the next question.
The timer resets to 60 seconds whenever the user moves to a new question (via Next, Skip, or auto-skip).
The timer text changes to red when 10 or fewer seconds remain.
The timer stops when the user selects an answer or manually clicks Next/Skip.

constraints: Do not modify any files listed under frontend.immutablePaths.
Maintain the existing parchment/teal/gold visual theme on all new UI elements.
nonGoals: Global quiz-level timer (total time for the entire quiz session is not required, only per-question timer).
Backend changes for storing skip data or timer results.
Configurable timer duration — 60 seconds per question is fixed.
